marta (PM): Quick heads-up — I published the incident brief for the serving degradation from last night: https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/1799990000-incident-brief. TL;DR: sudden KV-cache churn + degraded batching led to elevated p99s and 5xx spikes for ~22m.
zheng (SRE): Thanks, reading now. Added notes about OOM of kernel module and how the eviction spike correlated w/ autoscaler behaviour.
enrique (Eng lead): Skimming — looks solid. I pulled the perf graphs and annotated timeline. Main follow-ups below.
sarah (Support): FYI — customer comms sent to top 5 impacted accounts, template in the doc under "communications".
enrique (Eng lead): Action items (owners / due): 1) tighten autoscaler max burst -> @zheng (due 2026-03-30). 2) KV cache soft-limit alert + dashboard -> @anna (eng) (due 2026-04-05). 3) add end-to-end smoke for short sequences -> @enrique (due 2026-04-07).
zheng (SRE): Acked. I've scheduled the alert work for tomorrow. Also adding a step in the runbook to force-failover when cache hit-rate drops 30% within 5m.
marta (PM): Nice. I've added an owners table + success criteria in the doc. Please add checkboxes as you make progress.
ops-bot: Incident brief published by marta (PM) — https://redwood-internal.atlassian.net/wiki/spaces/OPS/pages/1799990000-incident-brief (automated message).
enrique (Eng lead): We'll do a 30-min sync to review progress and close items: Mon 2026-03-30 10:00 PT — calendar invite sent. If any owner can't make it, drop updates in the doc.
sarah (Support): Customer follow-ups will reference the update after the Mon sync.
marta (PM): Can owners please react with :white_check_mark: when they've started their task? I'll run check-ins Wed + next Mon. Thanks everyone.
